findings.current: “Do I know you? And what do you mean, a misunderstanding? Drag this traitorous bastard to the jail and throw him in.”
findings.defect: Hong Jin asks whether the man knows him, not whether Hong Jin knows the man.
findings.rationale: 당신 나 알아? makes the other man the subject of ‘know,’ preserving Hong Jin’s pointed response to his familiar address.
findings.replacement: “Do you know me? And what do you mean, a misunderstanding? Drag this traitorous bastard to the jail and throw him in.”
findings.source: 당신 나 알아? 그리고 오해는 무슨. 당장 이 역적 새끼 끌고 가서 형옥에 처박아요.

findings.current: “You already know, don’t you, old Deputy Military Commissioner?”
findings.defect: The general’s 도독첨사 is rendered as Deputy Military Commissioner, the established English title for Hong Jin’s different office, 도지휘동지.
findings.rationale: The two Korean office titles are distinct; using Hong Jin’s title here falsely gives the general the same office.
findings.replacement: “You already know, don’t you, old Assistant Military Commissioner?”

findings.current:
“W-wait! Deputy Hong!”

“I’m not a deputy anymore. It’s been ages since I was appointed Deputy Military Commissioner of Shanxi Province. Don’t make a scene calling me over. Go on ahead. Oh, and make sure you wash your balls.”
findings.defect: Calling Hong ‘Deputy’ makes his correction contradictory: the appointment he cites is itself rendered Deputy Military Commissioner. The man addresses him by an older penal-service title.
findings.rationale: Hong rejects 첩형 before naming his current office; the English must keep those positions distinct for the exchange to work.
findings.replacement:
“W-wait! Torturer Hong!”

“I’m not a torturer anymore. It’s been ages since I was appointed Deputy Military Commissioner of Shanxi Province. Don’t make a scene calling me over. Go on ahead. Oh, and make sure you wash your balls.”
findings.source:
“자, 잠깐! 홍 첩형(貼刑)!”

“나 첩형 아니에요. 산서성 도지휘동지로 임명된 지가 언젠데. 괜히 시끄럽게 사람 부르지 말고 먼저 가 있어요. 아, 불알 잘 닦아 놓고.”

findings.current: The question I still hadn’t resolved drifted faintly through my mind, like a breeze blowing in the early morning.
findings.defect: The draft drops the remembered voice and moves what lingers at his ears into his own thoughts.
findings.rationale: 그 목소리가 … 귓가를 맴돌았다 describes a voice lingering at his ears, alongside the unresolved question.
findings.replacement: The question remained unresolved, and that voice lingered faintly in my ears like a breeze at dawn.
findings.source:
― 그래, 너였구나.

아직 해결하지 못한 의문이, 그 목소리가 새벽에 불어온 바람처럼 아스라이 귓가를 맴돌았다.

― 무신(武神)께서 말씀하셨던, 선택받은 자가.

findings.current: *For that very Martial God to show up so suddenly.*
findings.defect: ‘Show up’ suggests the Martial God has appeared in person, though at this point he has only entered the conversation.
findings.rationale: The narrator immediately says he has never seen even the Martial God’s little finger and reacts to the mention of his title.
findings.replacement: *For the Martial God himself to come up so suddenly.*

findings.current: There were also outlandish stories that the Martial God had never been human at all, but a divine beast that protected the Central Plains, and that he no longer appeared in human form.
findings.defect: The draft turns a rumor that he was like a divine beast into the categorical claim that he had never been human.
findings.rationale: 신수와 같은 means ‘like a divine beast’; it does not assert that the Martial God was never human.
findings.replacement: There were also plenty of outlandish rumors that the Martial God was, by nature, something like a divine beast protecting the Central Plains, and that he no longer appeared in human form.
findings.source: 무신이란 본래 중원을 수호하는 신수(神獸)와 같은 존재라, 더는 인간의 모습으로 나타나지 않는다는 허무맹랑한 소문들도 심심찮게 나돌았다.

findings.current: Even to those who had been closest to the Martial God—and to me.
findings.defect: ‘Been closest’ implies a personal relationship rather than firsthand proximity and contact.
findings.rationale: 가장 가까이에서 … 보고 접했던 describes people who saw and encountered him at close range, without establishing intimacy.
findings.replacement: Even to those who had seen and encountered the Martial God up close—and to me.
findings.source: 가장 가까이에서 무신이라는 존재를 보고 접했던 이들에게도, 그리고 나에게도.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it reverses one question, conflates two offices, and makes several uncertain claims more definite than the source.
